evidence_identity: reconstructed policies on archived native results plus separately counted new native geometry branch
sensitivity_metric: D10 evaluated on frozen B8L2-selected teams
relation_identity: existing REPLAY_GROUPS supported declarations; no new room grouping

join_keys.group_id: archived supported replay panel, MVxxxx or coverage subset MVxxxxSx
join_keys.parent_group: original whole panel when this is a supported subset; does not create new room facts
join_keys.room_id: existing Gxxx room declaration identifier in archived rows
join_keys.image_id: full public image id; target_image uses the same identifier
join_keys.image_code: short public code; replay source uses column image
join_keys.team_id: frozen pool plus canonical member subset identity
join_keys.member_object_ids: pipe-delimited exact eligible source object identifiers
join_keys.ordered_workers: pipe-delimited exact arrival/collection order used in replay
join_keys.history: pipe-delimited observed source image ids, disjoint from target
join_keys.m: number of actual historical source images
join_keys.N: number of views in this existing supported panel

decisions.requested_k: prefix chosen from source history or fixed budget, before target geometry top-up
decisions.selected_k: actual final collected prefix; -1 if no supported choice
decisions.geometry_complete: geometry_status==ok, selected nodes>=4, connection available; no target reference quantity used
decisions.target_Q: evaluation only after selection; unknown/non-evaluable remains missing
decisions.full_common_pool: all available workers shared by the supported panel, not all annotators on each image
decisions.online_three_transitions_2deg: first k>=5 where four complete same-nodecount outputs have three consecutive native bound cyclic angular distances<=2 degrees; full pool fallback

summary_fields.attempts: repeated split-target-path attempts, never number of independent rooms
summary_fields.quality_available_rate: valid target outcomes divided by all attempts under stated hierarchy
summary_fields.geometry_complete_rate: complete target native geometry divided by all attempts
summary_fields.q_mean: available-case B8L2 mean under stated hierarchy
summary_fields.q10: target-level 10th percentile, then group/building average; not a pooled quantile
summary_fields.loss_gt5_to_full_rate_paired: fraction whose selected target Q is >5 below full common-pool Q, among actual paired evaluable outputs
summary_fields.loss_gt5_to_fixed7_geometry_rate_paired: fraction whose selected target Q is >5 below fixed7 plus same geometry-top-up rule, among paired outputs
summary_fields.loss_gt5_or_missing_rate_all: event flag combining missing output or >5-point full-pool loss; not a zero-imputed quality score
summary_fields.mean_activity_ratio_to_fixed7_geometry: mean of path-specific activity ratios; distinct from ratio of target means
summary_fields.ratio_mean_activity_to_fixed7_geometry: ratio after averaging paths within target/m, then target/group/building average; matches historical Pro time-ratio convention
summary_fields.same_final_k_random_available_q: average target Q over random actual paths at identical final k; available-case, completeness separately retained
summary_fields.same_requested_k_random_geometry_q: random actual paths start at same requested k then independently top up to complete geometry; final k may differ
summary_fields.activity_all_new_complete: fixed panel-wide support: all common workers new-origin and all source/target full-pool activity times known
summary_fields.project_ratio_to_fixed7_geometry: source full-curve activity plus all remaining target selected activity, divided by fixed7+geometry collection on all views in same historical split
summary_fields.project_ratio_to_full_common_pool: same project numerator divided by all views collected to full common pool
summary_fields.mean_source_full_activity_seconds: all common workers' annotation activity summed once per source image; permutations do not multiply it
summary_fields.median_break_even_future_target_views: conditional descriptive extrapolation only on paths with positive target savings; not a guaranteed observed payback or deployment forecast

time_contract.excluded: old-origin mixtures, unknown activity, reference-making labor, scoring labor, queue time and money conversion
time_contract.historical_source_cost: existing history is sunk for target-only comparison; from-zero source acquisition is separately computed

weighting: within actual m: repeated split/path average in target; target equal, supported group equal within building, building equal

supports.all_attempts: primary, including missing outcomes and failures
supports.dot_common_complete: conditional diagnostic; all candidate k except2 complete on every view, invariant across policies
supports.whole_group: six supported whole common-worker pools, 24 images, 6 buildings
supports.coverage_subset: 14 overlapping supported subpanels, 19 actual images, 3 buildings; never pooled into whole_group
supports.online_geometry_small_sample: three stable-hash archived orders per supported panel; 60 paths/43 images/2094 prefix references/1678 native geometry calls; not external validation

visual_features: online_G046_21_visual_manifest.json: explicit reference-corner indices and ERP1024x512 crop bounds; no new cross-view physical correspondence adjudication
